evidence.reason: Line 105 forces raw text diffs but leaves Git's rename detection enabled. With `git log -p`, a pure rename is emitted as rename metadata only, with no added content lines, while gitleaks scans added text. A file moved from an exempt path to a non-exempt path can therefore have its unchanged content, and path-based denylist rules for the new path, skipped by the blocking denylist scan. Adding `--no-renames` is the smallest compatible correctness fix; it makes such a move appear as a delete plus add so the new path's content is scanned.
